<div id="Dismiss">
<span id="toc53"></span>
<p id="_3ab7edc6-9b18-cd90-78ea-d5811f84c064">The Dismiss requirement class specifies how to dismiss a job. Dismiss can be seen as cancelling a running job or removing artifacts of a finished job.</p>
<span id="rc_dismiss"></span><!-- requirements-class -->
<div id="_operation_10"><h2 class="published-heading" id="toc54">13.1.  Operation</h2>
<span id="req_dismiss_job-dismiss-op"></span><!-- requirement: dismiss/job-dismiss-op -->
</div>
<div id="_response_9"><h2 class="published-heading" id="toc55">13.2.  Response</h2><span id="req_dismiss_job-dismiss-success"></span><!-- requirement: dismiss/job-dismiss-success -->
<p class="SourceTitle" style="text-align:center;">Example  — A dismissed job encoded as JSON.</p><div class="example" id="_2fdf74b2-439f-9d44-4f60-72d794eded51"><pre class="prettyprint" id="_4787100c-adf3-9729-b2e5-9d4dc11a6f90">{<br/>  "jobID" : "81574318-1eb1-4d7c-af61-4b3fbcf33c4f",<br/>  "status": "dismissed",<br/>  "message": "Job dismissed",<br/>  "progress": 56,<br/>  "links": [<br/>    {<br/>      "href": "http://processing.example.org/oapi-p/jobs",<br/>      "rel": "up",<br/>      "type": "application/json",<br/>      "title": "The job list of this server"<br/>    }<br/>  ]<br/>}</pre>
</div></div>
<div id="_error_situations_10"><h2 class="published-heading" id="toc56">13.3.  Error situations</h2><p id="_3eed6b9a-0ed0-9c9e-dde8-518296fef8ba">See <a href="#http_status_codes">Clause 7.5.1</a> for general guidance.</p>
<p id="_75b2f7d0-037d-be3d-cfd2-05ffde86323b">If the process with the specified identifier does not exist on the server, the status code of the response SHALL be <tt>404</tt> (see <a href="#req_core_process-exception-no-such-process">/req/core/process-exception/no-such-process</a>).</p>
<p id="_1143af1b-f2e7-d7f8-963a-31ff9578e554">If the job with the specified identifier does not exist, the status code of the
response SHALL be <tt>404</tt> (see <a href="#req_core_job-exception-no-such-job">/req/core/job-results-exception/no-such-job</a>).</p></div>
